title: MZ A few small questions in one-June 1

posts.author: MHDevBlue
posts.body:
1: The game seems to have a soft filter over it. It's very subtle, but it seems to not be sharp and pixelated like the sprites are. I changed the resolution to 1024x576. Is this the culprit? I'd like to keep the screen size as close to this as possible.
2: Is there a way that allows the overlaying of a picture over an entire map to simulate map-wide lighting? Think something like, the player is in a forest, and there is an overlay over the top of the map that gives the spotty, random lighting effect of the sun through leaves. Is this possible?
3: Is there a way I can turn down the master volume of a whole project? I've decided that the music ingame is a bit too loud, and it would be a pain to go through and turn down every individual song. I know it's not a disaster if I have to do that, but I'm wondering if there's a way to do it this way.
4: Is there a way to put a balloon over the top of a character who has a sidequest, that moves with them and goes away when it's finished?

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
1) make sure its can be divived by 48 (unless you choose a different tile size).
2) lightning plugin? or parallax mapping can solve this issue
3) there is a plugin to do that or by scriptcall for its base of the start of the game.
4) I believe MOG hunter has one if its ported from MV to MZ, which allows this
kind of thing.
you can also event it otherwise to make it more simple.

RPG Maker blurs the screen by default, even when the resolution is perfectly divisible by the tile size. You can use a plugin to turn off this behavior and get pixel perfect scaling.
Hakuen Studio Pixel Perfect for RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
Adds pixel perfect rendering for your rpg maker mz game!
hakuenstudio.itch.io

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
Did you try using Show Picture like I suggested?
You could probably get a parallax plugin for "above map" parallax for a cooler effect, but what you describe should be possible without any plugins using just a picture.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body: Well, your description didn't mention anything about moving with the player – a static image above the map seems to satisfy what you originally described. But if you do want it to move with the player, then parallax is definitely what you want. I don't know anything about the options available for parallax plugins in MZ though; I think possibly Galv had one for MV, but I've no idea if it was ported.
